metadata.description: Mod Manager (powermods-mod-manager): a /mod-manager side pane for Claude Code that updates, removes and reloads your mods

plugins.name: powermods-mod-manager
plugins.description: A /mod-manager side pane that runs the claude plugin commands you choose: every installed mod and plugin with update, auto-update, uninstall, enable/disable, reload and open actions, a background check that flags outdated mods, and adding marketplaces from a GitHub or GitLab URL
